newsitem.title: CROATIA: Two workers killed in Croatia mine explosion.
newsitem.headline: Two workers killed in Croatia mine explosion.

text.p: Two workers clearing mines from a destroyed bridge near a United Nations checkpoint in eastern Croatia were killed on Saturday when an anti-tank mine exploded, a police spokesman said.
Two other workers were injured, one of them seriously.
The bridge is in the area that formed the front line between Serbs and Croats in the Croatian independence war in 1991, just outside the town of Osijek.
The accident happened when an excavator drove over the mine, the spokesman said.

The checkpoint, manned by Russian UN soldiers, is at the border of Croatia and Eastern Slavonia, a Serb region under United Nations administration which is due to revert to Croatian government after the UN mandate expires in mid-July.
Croatia holds its first nationwide elections on Sunday when Serbs living in Eastern Slavonia will be included in the vote.
